title: Dynamics 365 Finance: ERP Analytics MCP gives agents access to Business performance analytics data
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, preview prerequisites, BPA controls and qualified billing statements are supported. One clarification is needed: the security page says the first user becomes an administrator, but the installation page says administrator setup is not automatic from BPA version 2.5.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No Analytics MCP server-specific licence, execution rate, meter or price is published at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "ERP Analytics MCP" licensing billing price meter credits enable disable API PowerShell; opened Analytics overview, technical details, FAQ, Studio guide, BPA overview, ERP MCP licensing and Studio Billing rates and management; no Analytics-specific execution pricing stated.

claims.claim: The separate ERP MCP server ordinarily bills Copilot Studio tool calls at its Agent Action rate.
claims.quote: When you use the MCP server in Copilot Studio, the tool calls align with the Agent Action feature, which bills at a fixed rate per tool call.

claims.claim: Qualifying authenticated Business-to-Employee Copilot USL use incurs no additional ERP MCP tool-call credit consumption.
claims.quote: In these cases, the tool calls to the Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server don't incur additional credit consumption.

claims.claim: ERP MCP execution on other clients costs 0.1 Copilot Credits per tool call for standard user licences.
claims.quote: For agents built on other agent clients, usage of the Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server incurs a cost of one copilot credit per 10 tool calls to the server (or 0.1 credits per tool call).

Agent not finding the MCP server

- Ensure you have appropriate permissions in your Power Platform environment.
